name: Project Tracker
summary: A local-first tracker for a portfolio of AI-agent projects and their MVP statements. A 1:1 clone of the aibast-agents-library project-tracker web tool, paired with a headless ProjectTracker agent. Both speak the tool's native projectTrackerData JSON, so exports and imports round-trip. Self-contained, stdlib-only, offline-capable.
tagline: Track AI-agent projects and their MVPs, local-first — a web UI plus a headless agent over one JSON.
egg_note: Self-contained. The UI runs standalone (localStorage) or unifies with the ProjectTracker agent's on-device store (~/.rapp/project-tracker) when the rapplication's local server is running. No shipped customer data.
